description: A short prose summary of Ethan's public GitHub contributions over the last 7 days. Plain third-person paragraph — quote it directly when summarizing what he's currently working on.

data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu made 31 GitHub contributions across three repositories: UTMIST/Misty, qiuethan/Portfolio, and qiuethan/now. He contributed 23 counts to UTMIST/Misty, 5 to qiuethan/Portfolio, and 3 to qiuethan/now, opened pull requests including UTMIST/Misty#263, #265, #267, and #269, and opened and reviewed pull requests in those repos as well. He reviewed UTMIST/Misty#230, #259, #261, #262, #264, and #268.
